headline: Ariana Grande WRAPS 🏁 Tour 🎤 and DIPS 🏃‍♀️ from Public Eye 👀
text:
Ariana Grande 🌟 just finished 🏁 her Eternal Sunshine ☀️ tour 🎫 in London 🏙️ with an emotional 😢 exit 🚪 on Tuesday 🌙 as she wrapped 🎁 up the whole thing 🧵 and prepared 🛠️ to step back ⬅️ from public life 👤 after months of getting RAILED 💦 by endless scrutiny 🔍!! The pop princess 👑 was close to tears 💧 especially during One Last Time ⏰ which hit different 🎯 as an anthem 🏆 for survivors 🛡️ of the 2017 Manchester terror attack 💥 and she even knelt 🙇‍♀️ down low 🪑 to get near the audience 👥 throughout the whole performance 🎭 saying "London 🏰 I'm gonna need you 🫵 to help me on this one" while the crowd went wild 🐺!!

Last month 📅 Grande announced 📢 her break ⏸️ from all future public-facing appearances 😶 after intense speculation 🧐 about her health 🩹 and appearance 👗 which led to her pulling out 🚫 of that Stephen Sondheim production 🎭 of Sunday in the Park with George 🪑 at London's Barbican next summer 🌞 alongside her Wicked 🧹 co-star Jonathan Bailey 🕺 who also dipped 🏃‍♂️ out on Tuesday 🌙!! On stage 🎤 in London though she showed zero signs ❌ of fragility 🥀 or poor health 🏥 other than a foot injury 🦶 that forced her to swap 👟 her trademark stilettos 👠 for knee-high platform boots 🥾 yet she still sprang 🦘 across the stage like a pro 🏅 in sync with her dancers 🕺 often on tip-toe 🩰 to make up for the lost height 📏 and her voice only faltered once 😶 during Nowhere Nobody 🌌 when she sang "Hard to believe in a perfect ending" 🎬 but she quickly regained composure 🧘‍♀️ and stayed magnetic 🧲 the entire night 🌃!!

The star ⭐ has told fans 🪭 she may not tour 🚌 again for a "long long" time ⏳ after this one last hurrah 🥳 and she addressed the audience 🗣️ toward the end 🏁 thanking them for support 🙌 saying "This has been one of the most beautiful extraordinary experiences of my life 🌟 and I just wanted to express my gratitude without sobbing completely 😭" while promising to cherish it forever 💎!! She added that she has the best fans in the entire world 🌍 and loved every minute ⏰ with them making sure to express how grateful she is 🙏 after releasing her latest single Petal 🌸 video which sparked concern 😟 about her weight ⚖️ leading her publicist to announce the "step back from visibility" due to endless ongoing public scrutiny 🔦!!

A source close to the singer 👄 told People magazine 📰 that she performs a very physical show 💪 healthily and successfully at a very high level night after night 🌙 and Grande herself reassured fans 🫂 the decision came from a "thoughtful empowered place" 🧠 planned a long time ago 🗓️ telling the Chicago crowd that boundaries need to be set 🛑 and human beings do need a break sometimes 😌 even though the Eternal Sunshine tour marked her return after a seven-year absence 🕰️!! She had already described it as her "one last hurrah" 🏇 before wanting to take more acting roles 🎥 after her Oscar-nominated performance in Wicked 🧙‍♀️ which made her 10-show residency at London's O2 Arena 🏟️ the last chance for many fans who flew in from China 🇨🇳 Australia 🇦🇺 and all across Europe 🇪🇺 with 200000 people attending the London dates alone 🧳!!

On the second night 🌃 she surprised everyone 🎉 by bringing out her Wicked co-star Cynthia Erivo 🌈 for a rendition of their movie duet For Good 🎶 and across the board reviews were positive 👍 with Rolling Stone calling her one of the best singers of her generation 👑 noting no signs of struggling or not wanting to be there 😊 while The Telegraph praised its flawless Hollywood-indebted staging 🎥 and her genuine affection for Britain 🇬🇧!! My own review highlighted quieter songs like Imperfect For You feeling delicate and gorgeous 🌺 in a room of 20000 people 👥 but some writers like Guardian's Kate Solomon admitted being gripped by genuine concern 😟 even while enjoying it and hoping the tour doesn't go down for the wrong reasons 🚫 though NME was left breathless by her physical prowess 🏋️‍♀️ marveling how she skips across the stage in skyscraper heels 👠 that most drag performers would baulk at until that final night when a "deep cut" on her foot 🩸 made her go with the knee-high platforms instead yet she still finished with a huge smile 😄 leaning into big notes of Dangerous Woman ⚠️ and sprinting during Break Free 🏃‍♀️ before ending attached to a harness 🪢 ascending into the rafters and disappearing into the sky ☁️ leaving fans wondering when if ever they'd see her perform again 🎤!!

Many fans showed up in her signature "bunny ears" look 🐰 including Rachid from London who said he was "devastated" 😞 by her withdrawal and came to the last show because "What if she never comes back" 🥺 while Manchester fan Nadine joked she'd do the same after making her money 💰 singing her heart out ❤️ and buggering off to Hawaii 🏝️ where nobody knows who she is!! Lukas from France 🇫🇷 said it was good to see her taking matters into her own hands ✋ for her safety 🛡️ and real fans understand if she needs the break ⏸️ and Polish fan Alejandro Grande insisted it's sad people speculate about someone else's health 🩺 and that she has to reclaim her power ⚡ and energy 🔋 with Bella Hopkins agreeing it's completely up to her and people should respect how she feels and what she needs 🙌 after this tour that left everyone emotional and grateful 🌟.
